headline: Your voice is part of Soma too
intro: Your notes help us improve Soma: what broke, what could work better, or what you would like to see. We read every note. This is not a medical channel and we cannot promise when we will reply.
privacy: Your message stays in your account. We do not publish it, and it is not a clinical record. Avoid passwords, personal health details, or anything you would not want stored.
demoNotice: Demo mode: this form shows how Help and suggestions will look. Nothing is saved to an account.
withdrawnNotice: You have withdrawn consent for substance-use, abstinence, and wellbeing data. You can still send product feedback, but do not include personal information about substance use, abstinence, or health.
categoriesLabel: What would you like to share?
bodyPlaceholder: What happened, or what you would like to see. A few honest sentences are enough.
confirmation: Thank you. We have received your note. You can see it below with its status.
duplicate: This looks the same as a note you sent in the last 24 hours. We kept the earlier one instead of adding a copy.
historyHint: Only you see this list in Soma. Status is updated by the team when they look at a note.
empty: You have not sent any notes yet. When you do, they will appear here.

errors.title: Write a short title (at least 3 characters, up to 80).
errors.body: Add a little more detail (at least 20 characters, up to 4,000).
errors.network: We could not send your note. Check your connection and try again.
errors.load: We could not load your notes. Try again in a moment.
